listing.name: Ace Combat 04: Shattered Skies — Ace-Combat-04-Static-Recompilation (SatyaSujitPasupuleti)
listing.summary: The project reports a Mission 2 test for this proof of concept. Frame stalls, saving, loading and Alt+Tab need further testing; a complete campaign is unconfirmed. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA SLUS-20152 ISO. This guide does not specify this project’s exact accepted file hash. A hash from the separate PresidentRaptor project does not establish a match for this build.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the project’s Windows source-generation and build instructions using build.cmd or build.ps1 with MSYS2. The project does not distribute a completed game executable.

warnings: The project reports a Mission 2 test for this proof of concept. Frame stalls, saving, loading and Alt+Tab need further testing; a complete campaign is unconfirmed.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
